subject: an Enramados smithy workshop seen as a side elevation: a long low tiled roof with a thick eave, an offset fieldstone chimney joined to the roof, an open work bay with the forge mouth and the anvil, timber posts and braces carrying the roof, a stone plinth resting on the ground

brief.story: built by the Enramados woodfolk under great oaks, of damp fieldstone and heavy timber; the smith works in the open bay and soot marks the wall above the forge mouth
brief.light: a warm forge glow inside the bay and one lantern under the eave

references.note: o conceito da oficina: silhueta, partes e materiais; reorganizado e com alfa parcial, nao e um recorte do panorama
a oficina no panorama: relacao com a arvore, o chao e a casa; a escala vem do barril dela, nao da porta da casa
